basis: Coordinator source review; business owner independently confirmed the version/payload race; runtime verification pending
observation: A fixed secret reference reused across configuration versions permits an old worker to read the newer encrypted complete payload after it has checked the old configuration version.
agreed_design: Immutable secret reference per configuration version; authenticated encryption context binds configuration identity and version; worker verifies decoded payload identity/version and public parameters before application; secret documents remain local to the owning node.
required_cases: Old worker paused after version read, then newer configuration saved, then old worker proceeds
Newer version applies before delayed older task; actual revision guard prevents overwrite
Public detail, sync, queries and evidence expose only references or safe metadata, preserving existing credential handling
